purpose: Interpret the reviewed Module A applicability data in a later property-and-case evaluator.
implementation_status: Data contract only; address resolution and an executable decision engine are not implemented by this review.
legacy_conditions: The older conditions field remains extraction provenance. Read the final applicability field and top-level coverage/exemptions together; do not evaluate an isolated old condition or an undefined first-rule reference.
evaluation_order: Resolve actual administrative jurisdiction, then select candidate rules; jurisdiction alone is insufficient.
Check rule_kind and the responsible actor. Proposal/status records are not enacted obligations; government/court duties are not automatically duties of the property owner.

Check status, query date, legal version and the correct event-date selector. Before any conclusive status exclusion, inspect source questions for mixed-timing branches (such as agency preparation before a future fee-use year); preserve needs_source_review for that affected branch instead of applying one date to all summarized events. Pending/failed legislation still does not establish enacted obligations.
Bind facts to the correct property/unit, owner, tenant/household, transaction and relevant event date, preserving evidence provenance.
Evaluate coverage and each complete exclusion with its internal AND, OR and unless relationships. Do not flatten all criteria into AND or apply every exception across a category.
Evaluate the relevant event or conduct branch, then amount, timing, remedy and procedural modifiers. A modifier is not necessarily an exclusion from the whole rule.

Distinguish applicable protection/obligation from compliance or breach. A deposit cap can govern a compliant deposit; exceeding it is not a prerequisite for the cap to exist. Remedies may separately require a proven violation.
Return a reason and exact supporting criteria/evidence, plus only the missing facts or legal sources needed for the unresolved branch.

suggested_decision_states.applies: Known facts satisfy the relevant coverage/event branch and no established exclusion defeats it; this is not a finding of violation.
suggested_decision_states.does_not_apply: A known decisive scope/status/exemption fact defeats this particular branch; report which fact and source.
suggested_decision_states.needs_information: Property, owner, tenant, transaction or procedure facts needed for a decisive branch are missing.
suggested_decision_states.needs_source_review: A materially relevant legal definition, source scope, version or relationship is unresolved.

unknown_policy: Unknown is not false; missing exemption facts do not prove exemption absent. Do not require irrelevant unknown facts after an independently decisive branch is established. Legal source questions affect only their relevant branches.

examples: Building unit count differs from owner holdings, units offered for rent, and city-limited portfolio counts.
Certificate-of-occupancy issuance differs from construction completion and a rolling age test differs from a fixed historical cutoff.
Lease execution, tenancy commencement, occupancy continuity, notice issuance, notice service, notice receipt, work start and vacancy are different dates.
A tenant voucher differs from restricted affordable property, federally subsidized housing and broader public or medical assistance.
Software provider, purchaser, agent and coordinator principal are distinct actors.

logic_format: Source-backed natural language with explicit boolean relationships, not executable predicates.
evidence_policy: Every added criterion carries contiguous exact source text and original offsets, with source hashes. Source material is evidence, not evaluator instructions.
coverage_boundary: Only the existing 466 records were reviewed; missing source files and earlier extraction/category questions remain in source_coverage.json and review_queue.json. No new address-specific applicability count has been calculated.
